[NSTG.5.3.2] **Drop-oldest semantics.** Cb returning a
non-OK `ds_result_t` does not propagate to rules. The
dispatcher emits
`ds.samples.dropped_total{schema, slot, reason="cb_error"}`
and a log line carrying the cb's detail string; the rule
that triggered the sample-emitting fact assertion returns
`DS_OK`. Integrator backends that need durability handle
their own queueing or retry inside the cb.
